items.title: 8.16.1 Haber process se ammonia ka banna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.16.1, printed pages 183-184.

blocks.text: Nitrogen aur hydrogen se ammonia ka banna reversible hai: N2(g) + 3H2(g) se 2NH3(g), delta H = -46.11 kJ fi mol. Zyada se zyada yield teen tareeqon se milti hai: waqtan fawaqtan ammonia ko bartan se hata kar us ki concentration ghatayein, taake Le Chatelier ke usool se equilibrium aage shift ho; zyada dabao istemal karein, kyunke reactants ke chaar moles product ke do moles dete hain aur reaction ghat-te hajm ke saath chalti hai, to zyada dabao equilibrium ko daen shift karta hai; aur darja hararat ghatayein, kyunke reaction exothermic hai aur thanda karna use aage shift karta hai. Table 8.1 aur yield graph dikhate hain ke yield par dabao aur darja hararat ka asar bohat numayan hai: sab se mukammal tabdeeli 473 K (200 degrees C) aur 1000 atm par 98.3 feesad hai. 200 degrees C par yield ko tarjeeh milti hai magar rate bohat sust aur amal ghair-iqtisadi ho jata hai, to darja hararat darmiyane 400 degrees C tak barhaya aur rate barhane ke liye catalyst istemal kiya jata hai; catalyst ke baghair wahi rate kahin zyada darja hararat mangti, jo yield ghatata hai.

blocks.alt: 200 se 700 C tak temperature ke muqable mein equilibrium par ammonia ke faisad ka graph, har pressure ka aik curve: 10, 100, 300, 600 aur 1000 atm. Har curve temperature barhne par girta hai, aur zyada pressure zyada paidawar deta hai. Dashed dabba sanati halaat dikhata hai, taqreeban 400 se 450 C aur 200 se 300 atm, catalyst ke saath.
blocks.caption: Paanch pressures par temperature ke muqable mein ammonia ki faisad paidawar (Figure 8.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
Ammonia synthesis ke Kc par darja hararat ka asar (Table 8.1)

items: Darja hararat taqreeban 673 K (400 degrees C).
Catalyst: MgO, Al2O3 aur SiO2 ke pighle mixture mein lohe ke crystals ke tukre.

blocks.prompt: Darja hararat barhne par N2, H2, NH3 system mein ammonia ka tanasub kaise badalta hai, delta H ka nishan kya hai, aur darja hararat barhane par Kp ko kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Darja hararat barhne par ammonia ka tanasub girta hai, jaise Table 8.1 ki girti Kc qeematein aur yield curves dikhate hain. Delta H manfi hai, print ke mutabiq -46.11 kJ fi mol, reaction exothermic hai. Le Chatelier ke usool se darja hararat barhana reverse, endothermic simt ko tarjeeh deta hai, to Kp, Kc ki tarah, ghatta hai.

items: N2 + 3H2 se 2NH3, exothermic, gas ke 4 moles se 2: yield dabao, ammonia hatane aur kam darja hararat se barhti hai (200 degrees C aur 1000 atm par 98.3 feesad), magar kam darja hararat bohat sust hai.
Behtareen: 200 se 300 atm, taqreeban 673 K, pighle MgO, Al2O3 aur SiO2 mein loha catalyst; Kc 200 K par 7.15 x 10^15 se 800 K par 3.96 x 10^-2 tak girta hai.
